summary: Review repeated-measures, longitudinal and clustered designs for independent unit, within-cluster dependence, time structure, attrition and estimand alignment.

must_inspect.why: Inference must respect the actual independent unit rather than treating repeated observations as independent.
false_positive_guards: Repeated observations are not automatically pseudoreplication when dependence is modeled appropriately.

must_inspect.why: Time-varying missingness and attrition can change the analyzed population and estimand.
false_positive_guards: Do not label attrition bias without examining timing, reasons and analysis assumptions.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
